payload.title: Anth.us Papyrus: confirm with Ryan — directory-style /articles/<slug>/ vs /articles/<slug>.html
payload.description:
BLOCKED on Ryan. Needs one word: directory-style or `.html`.

## The question
Ryan settled the NAMESPACE ("We really want to use /articles/ but we need to support redirects from /blog/") but never stated the PATH SHAPE. PR #3 (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus/pull/3) implements directory-style — `/articles/<slug>/`, `/about/` — NOT `/articles/<slug>.html`. That choice was an inference made for him, not his words. It needs confirming before the PR merges.

## Why directory-style was chosen
- Production anth.us is directory-style today. Measured live: `/blog/can-you-fix-it/` 200, `/about/` 200, `/solutions/SQLBot/` 200.
- Ryan wrote both `/articles/` and `/blog/` WITH trailing slashes.
- Amplify Hosting prefers it and normalizes toward it on its own. Measured against production: `/about.html` -> 301 `/about/`, `/articles/can-you-fix-it.html` -> 301 `/articles/can-you-fix-it/`, `/blog/can-you-fix-it` -> 301 `/blog/can-you-fix-it/`. So the old staging `.html` URLs will self-heal once the directories exist; no rule needed for them.
- The `.html` shape was an artifact of Papyrus's Markus static build (`build_markus_site` writes `articles/<slug>.html`), not a deliberate decision.

## Cost of being wrong: one line
The shape is a single configuration point, `URL_STYLE` in `web/anthus_urls.py`, read from env `ANTHUS_URL_STYLE`. Setting `ANTHUS_URL_STYLE=html` switches the entire site back to extensions — pages, every internal link, canonical tags, og:url, the sitemap, and every redirect TARGET — with no other edit. `page_url()` and `page_output()` are the only two functions that decide a URL; nothing in the build concatenates `".html"` onto a slug.

The 301 redirect SOURCES are unaffected either way: they are the live Gatsby URLs, which are directory-style regardless.

## What to do once answered
- Directory-style confirmed: nothing to change. Proceed with PPY-d81a8c step 2 (deploy).
- `.html` wanted instead: set `ANTHUS_URL_STYLE=html` in `amplify.yml`'s build command (and in the local deploy build), rebuild, regenerate `web/custom-rules.json`, re-apply with `bin/apply_custom_rules.py --apply`. Re-run the dist link check — it should still report 0 refs landing on a redirect source.
